title: Receiver reliance assumptions (outside FHIR)
warning: The complete expectation boundary is an external agreement/receiver policy, not an HL7 FHIR R4 primitive or claim made by this example. Never infer all external obligations merely from Bundle contents.

case1_missing_B.description: Two independently ordered examinations are agreed to exhaust this synthetic group, but B report is unavailable to the receiver.

case2_both_received.description: Two independently ordered examinations are agreed to exhaust this synthetic group, and both report resources are present.

case3_only_A_known.description: Only examination A is in receiver-visible requests; no evidence establishes that the receiver knows the full obligation set.
